title: Analysis of pro-Israel product boycott: An empirical study of trust and purchase decisions of food and beverage products in Indonesia
core_idea: Explore how consumer trust, shaped by a social-media-driven boycott of pro-Israel products, influences purchasing decisions for food and beverage products on Instagram in Indonesia. The study targets followers of the @gerakanbds account using a purposive survey (n=160, ages 17–40) and analyzes relationships via path analysis (SmartPLS).
tldr: Investigates whether trust formed through an Instagram boycott movement affects Indonesian consumers' F&B purchase decisions, using a purposive survey of @gerakanbds followers and path analysis; focuses on trust, social responsibility, and buying behavior without reporting outcomes.
